fields.Name: T76 - Marketing Campaign Drilldown
fields.Description: Verifies a Campaign's related Campaign Members or Email Sends can be reached from the full record form and that related rows render.

InputDefinition.goal: In MJ Explorer, go to Data Explorer (Data section) and open the 'Campaigns' entity from the entity tree. Select a campaign row and click 'Open Full Record' to load the full campaign form. On that form, locate the related Campaign Members or Email Sends section/tab and view it, confirming related rows are displayed (or a valid empty-state). Pages can take 10-30s to load - wait, do not navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A Campaign full record form is open showing campaign detail fields
A related Campaign Members or Email Sends section/tab is visible with related rows (or a valid empty-state)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
